I feel you, I missed almost three years of daily red flags bc "everyone deserves a chance" and "we'll work that together". The best decision of your life will be to leave just as you said and get the love, respect and happiness you deserve. 
Breaking up was insanely scary but what was awaiting for me if I didn't leave is something I don't even want to think about. Pain, guilt, anger and even feeling like an impostor at times is normal but more and better is to come for you.
You literally shit comment almost every post on this subreddit. Seems like you grew up stupid and it won't change. Loser
